recording.value: Rule 3 — territorial: sound recording public domain in the European Union (pre-1963 publication basis).
recording.note: Commons applies PD-EU-audio and attributes the Markevitch/Lamoureux recording to 1962; the dossier separately preserves the label’s 1961 session documentation. Both candidate years precede 1963. Usable under the programme’s pre-1963 European sound-recording rule; the former 50-year term had expired before the 2013 extension. This is territorial, not a worldwide licence; US sound-recording status is not established. A recording date alone is not represented as an independently verified first-publication date.
